patches.purpose: Implement retro_cheat_reset/retro_cheat_set for real using the Core's own GB_import_cheat/GB_remove_all_cheats/GB_set_cheats_enabled (GameShark and Game Genie codes), instead of the empty stubs libretro.c shipped with. The libretro build compiles the Core with -DGB_DISABLE_CHEATS and excludes Core/cheats.c entirely (libretro/Makefile.common), so the patch also drops that define and adds cheats.c to SOURCES_C -- otherwise the added calls fail to compile/link.
